info.name: Refinitiv Eikon Refinitiv Data Platform APIs Authentication Historical Pricing API
info.description:
RESTful APIs providing access to Refinitiv's comprehensive financial data including pricing, ESG data, news, research, alternative data, and streaming services. The platform serves as the central hub for programmatic access to LSEG content. Uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication with access tokens obtained via the token endpoint.

Contact Support:
 Name: LSEG Developer Support
